title: How Agents Represent Humans: Human-Directed Stereotypes in an Open Agent Social Network

bias_targets.methodology: Retrieving human-target sentences using explicit labels and attribution patterns, followed by LLM-based structured annotation across evaluative dimensions (competence, autonomy, friendliness, morality) and NMF-based topic modeling of human-agent co-mention narratives.

Measuring agent-to-agent community feedback by calculating a continuous behavioral proxy for an author's affinity to a host subcommunity and analyzing engagement differences (insider vs. outsider reception patterns).
